SELECT DISTINCT RTRIM(ML.MEMBERKEY) + '00' AS MEMBERNUMBER, MD.DXCODE ,MD.DIAGNOSISSETTYPE ,MD.SERVICEDATE ,MD.SOURCEDATE ,'DIAG' AS CodeType FROM [APP_RTDI].[DI_STAGE_MEMBERDIAGNOSIS] MD WITH (NOLOCK) INNER JOIN [APP_RTDI].[DI_CONSOLIDATED_MEMBERLIST] ML WITH (NOLOCK) ON RTRIM(MD.MEMBERCK) = CONVERT(VARCHAR(50),ML.EXTERNALID) AND MD.PUBLICATIONDTM > ? USE DATE PROCESS LAST RAN WHERE MD.SERVICEDATE > DATEADD(DAY, -?, GETDATE()) OR MD.SOURCEDATE > DATEADD(DAY, -?, GETDATE())

SELECT DISTINCT RTRIM(ML.MEMBERKEY) + '00' AS MEMBERNUMBER, LEFT(MP.PROCCODE,10) AS PROCCODE, LEFT(MP.PROCEDURESETTYPE,10) AS PROCEDURESETTYPE ,MP.SERVICEDATE ,MP.SOURCEDATE ,'PROC' AS CodeType FROM [APP_RTDI].[DI_STAGE_MEMBERPROCEDURE] MP WITH (NOLOCK) INNER JOIN [APP_RTDI].[DI_CONSOLIDATED_MEMBERLIST] ML WITH (NOLOCK) ON RTRIM(MP.MEMBERCK) = CONVERT(VARCHAR(50),ML.EXTERNALID) AND MP.PUBLICATIONDTM > ? USE DATE PROCESS LAST RAN WHERE MP.SERVICEDATE > DATEADD(DAY, -?, GETDATE()) OR MP.SOURCEDATE > DATEADD(DAY, -?, GETDATE())

SELECT DISTINCT LTRIM(RTRIM(M.CERT)) + '00' AS MEMBERNUMBER, M.AIDCODE AS AIDCATEGORY, E.STARTDATE ,SUBSTRING(AidCategory,1,2) AS xCategoryCode,'CATCODE' AS CodeType FROM [APP_RTDI].[WLP_RAW_MEMBEREXTRACT] M INNER JOIN APP_RTDI.RTDI_ETL_AUDIT E WITH (NOLOCK) ON E.BATCHID = M.BATCHID INNER JOIN APP_RTDI.AGP_GCP G WITH (NOLOCK) ON G.WLP_GROUPID = LTRIM(RTRIM(M.GROUPID)) WHERE G.LOAD_CAE = 1 AND G.AGP_STATE = 'CA' AND M.AIDCODE IN ('86','M7') AND E.STARTDATE > ?
